$meta.name: Robo Presentation Component Contract
$meta.description: Reusable presentation primitives. Components support layouts; they do not replace semantic layout selection.

rules: Use components to reinforce meaning, not to simulate a technical aesthetic.
Use real technical content in terminal or code treatments.
Use the same component for the same semantic role within one deck.
Prefer a small vocabulary of repeated components to ad hoc decoration.

constraints: Small and subordinate to the title.
Never use as the main title.

components.purpose: One metric plus a short interpretation.
Show real agent, API, prompt, command, or system activity.
Represent a human, agent, service, data source, or system in a flow.
Show source, assumption, status, or evidence metadata at low visual weight.
constraints: Keep below the main reading hierarchy.
